description: Mock GLEIF LEI reference data used to evaluate EMIR validation rules R023, R024, R043 and R044 from validation_rules.json. In production these checks call the live GLEIF API/Golden Copy file; this file stands in for that lookup in tests.
notes: R023/R024 (ERROR) fail when registrationStatus is NOT 'ISSUED' or 'LAPSED' (e.g. RETIRED, DUPLICATE, MERGED, ANNULLED).
R043 (WARNING) fires when nextRenewalDate is within 30 days of the trade's ReportingTimestamp.
R044 (WARNING) fires when Counterparty2LEI.registrationStatus = 'LAPSED' (LAPSED still passes R023/R024, since LAPSED is an accepted status for those error checks).
Any LEI in a trade record that does not appear in this table should be treated as NOT_FOUND and fail R023/R024.

Records 1-6 are the original hand-built synthetic fixtures (LEIs 5493001KJTIIGC8Y1R12, 213800D1EI4B9WTWWD28, 724500ABCDEFGH123474, 969500RETIREDLEI0035, 788500LAPSEDLEI00007, 529900RENEWALDUE0021) and are kept verbatim so existing expected results stay valid.

Records 7 onward are real entities pulled from the GLEIF public API (https://api.gleif.org/api/v1/lei-records) -- real LEIs, legal names, registration statuses and renewal dates, normalised to this file's schema (GLEIF ISO timestamps truncated to YYYY-MM-DD). 'managingLOU' therefore holds the managing LOU's own 20-character LEI, not the RA000463-style code used by the six synthetic records.
GLEIF is a live registry: statuses and nextRenewalDate values in the real records reflect the registry at fetch time and will drift. Re-fetch rather than hand-edit if they need refreshing.

LEIs used by the trade CSVs as deliberate failure cases (213800MELBOURNEFI001, 894500ZZTOPCOUNTER01, 549300TOKYOBANKCORP1, INVALIDLEI*, 969500UNKNOWNLEI*, 788500LAPSEDLEI00019/87/142, 529900RENEWALDUE0088/0155/0266) are deliberately absent from this table.
